title: Deduplication preserves a list-wide test
statement: For every list $l$ of natural numbers and every Boolean-valued function $p$ on the natural numbers, applying the test that every entry satisfies $p$ gives the same result on $l$ and on the list obtained by removing repeated entries from $l$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list of natural numbers
$p$ is a Boolean-valued function on the natural numbers
